title: I have done (present perfect 1)
summary: Present perfect (**have / has + past participle**) — действие в прошлом, у которого есть **результат сейчас**: «я потерял ключи» (и их нет).
ru:
## Когда используем
Present perfect связывает прошлое и настоящее: что-то **произошло**, и мы видим **результат сейчас**.
> I'**ve lost** my passport. — Я потерял паспорт. (и сейчас не могу его найти)
> She'**s gone** to bed. — Она легла спать. (она сейчас в постели)
> We'**ve bought** a new car. — Мы купили новую машину. (теперь она у нас есть)
> He **has cleaned** his shoes. — Он почистил туфли. (они чистые сейчас)
Нам важен не момент в прошлом, а то, **что есть сейчас**.

## Как образуется
**have / has + причастие прошедшего времени (past participle)**
- **have** — I / we / you / they
- **has** — he / she / it
> I **have** finished. She **has** started. They **have** gone out.
Краткие формы: **I've, you've, we've, they've, he's, she's, it's**.
Отрицание: **haven't / hasn't + причастие**
> I **haven't bought** her a present. — Я не купил ей подарок.
Вопрос: **Have / Has + подлежащее + причастие?**
> **Have** you **finished** with it? — Ты закончил с этим?
> Where **has** he **gone**? — Куда он ушёл?

## Причастие (past participle)
- **Правильные глаголы**: причастие = past simple (**-ed**): clean → cleaned, finish → finished, start → started.
- **Неправильные**: иногда совпадает с past simple, иногда нет.

| Глагол | Past simple | Past participle |
|---|---|---|
| buy | bought | **bought** |
| have | had | **had** |
| lose | lost | **lost** |
| break | broke | **broken** |
| see | saw | **seen** |
| fall | fell | **fallen** |
| go | went | **gone** |
| do | did | **done** |
| take | took | **taken** |
| forget | forgot | **forgotten** |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have lost my keys yesterday.~~ → I **lost** my keys yesterday. (с yesterday, last week — past simple)
- ~~She have gone.~~ → She **has** gone.
- ~~He has went.~~ → He has **gone**.
- ~~I have saw it.~~ → I have **seen** it.
- ~~Has she finish?~~ → Has she **finished**?
en:
## When do we use it?
The present perfect connects the past and the present. Something **happened**, and there is a **result now**.
> I'**ve lost** my passport. (I can't find it now)
> She'**s gone** to bed. (she is in bed now)
> We'**ve bought** a new car. (we have a new car now)
> He **has cleaned** his shoes. (they are clean now)
The important thing is not **when** it happened, but **what is true now**.

## How to make it
**have / has + past participle**
- **have** — I / we / you / they
- **has** — he / she / it
> I **have** finished. She **has** started. They **have** gone out.
Short forms: **I've, you've, we've, they've, he's, she's, it's**.
Negative: **haven't / hasn't + past participle**
> I **haven't bought** her a present.
Question: **Have / Has + subject + past participle?**
> **Have** you **finished** with it?
> Where **has** he **gone**?

## Past participle
- **Regular verbs**: the same as the past simple (**-ed**): clean → cleaned, finish → finished.
- **Irregular verbs**: sometimes the same as the past simple, sometimes different.

| Verb | Past simple | Past participle |
|---|---|---|
| buy | bought | **bought** |
| have | had | **had** |
| lose | lost | **lost** |
| break | broke | **broken** |
| see | saw | **seen** |
| go | went | **gone** |
| do | did | **done** |
| take | took | **taken** |

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have lost my keys yesterday.~~ → I **lost** my keys yesterday. (with yesterday, last week we use the past simple)
- ~~She have gone.~~ → She **has** gone.
- ~~He has went.~~ → He has **gone**.
- ~~I have saw it.~~ → I have **seen** it.
structure:
## Утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
| Подлежащее | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | I have lost → I've lost | I haven't lost | Have you lost? |
| he / she / it | she has lost → she's lost | she hasn't lost | Has she lost? |

## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Have I / we / you / they ...? | Yes, I / we / you / they **have**. | No, I / we / you / they **haven't**. |
| Has he / she / it ...? | Yes, he / she / it **has**. | No, he / she / it **hasn't**. |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **have / has** + **past participle**
> I **have lost** my keys. · She **has gone** out. · **Have** you **seen** my bag?

## Причастия
| Тип | Правило | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Правильные | + ed (= past simple) | cleaned, finished, started, decided |
| Совпадает с past simple | особая форма | bought, had, lost, made, found, told |
| Отличается от past simple | особая форма | broke → broken, saw → seen, took → taken, went → gone, did → done, forgot → forgotten |

## Present perfect или past simple?
| Present perfect | Past simple |
|---|---|
| результат сейчас: I've lost my keys. | время названо: I lost my keys yesterday. |

## Особенности
- **have gone** = ушёл и ещё не вернулся: *She's gone to bed.*
- **been** — причастие от be: *I've been to Paris.* (см. дальше в курсе)

exercises.title: Закончите предложения
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present perfect.

items.text: Can I have this newspaper? — Yes, I {{have finished|'ve finished}} with it.
I {{have bought|'ve bought}} some new shoes. Do you want to see them?
Where is Liz? — She {{has gone|'s gone}} out.
Look! Somebody {{has broken|'s broken}} that window.
I can't find my umbrella. Somebody {{has taken|'s taken}} it.
I know that woman but I {{have forgotten|'ve forgotten}} her name.
Sue is having a party tonight. She {{has invited|'s invited}} a lot of people.

options: I have lost my keys yesterday.

exercises.title: Что случилось?
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение в present perfect по подсказке.

answers: We have bought a new car.
I haven't bought her a present.
I have not bought her a present.
They have not finished their work.

items.prompt: Он уже ушёл на работу. (результат: его нет дома)

answers: We have not finished the lesson.
We have not finished our lesson.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения о недавних событиях в вашей жизни. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Что вы только что сделали (результат виден сейчас)?
items.sample: I've cleaned my room. It's tidy now.

items.prompt: Куда ушёл кто-то из вашей семьи?
items.sample: My brother has gone to the gym.
